assurance_matrix.scope: Convert IE task grant into an ordered, policy-validated DevelopmentPlan
assurance_matrix.evidence: DEV-PLAN converts valid task grants into ordered 6-step sequential plans without performing file mutations or runtime executions.

assurance_matrix.scope: Task grant, policy envelope, tenant scope, token budget
assurance_matrix.evidence: Fails closed on None grant, expired grants, unauthorized worker roles (e.g. STRATEGY), missing tenant scope, and unauthorized capabilities.

assurance_matrix.scope: SandboxCapability.CODE read-only profile and network policy
assurance_matrix.evidence: NetworkPolicy is strictly DISABLED. Permitted tools are read-only inspection primitives (file_inspector, symbol_extractor, dependency_inspector, schema_introspector, manifest_parser).
Micro-tool execute_s_code denies all write operations in read-only mode with security_violation=True. Path traversal patterns (../, /etc/, .env) are blocked fail-closed.

All required fields populated: plan_id, task_id, workflow_id, attempt_id, plan_version, architecture_summary, change_impact_summary, affected_files, steps, risk_class, assumptions, unresolved_items, discovered_facts, plan_hash, status. Steps contain order, name, description, capabilities, tools, acceptance_criteria.

assurance_matrix.scope: Controlled fixture with known AST classes, functions, imports, dependencies
assurance_matrix.evidence: Extracted AST symbols (OrderModel, OrderService) and parsed dependencies (fastapi, pydantic) into discovered_facts without filesystem mutations.

assurance_matrix.scope: CMS/UI/CODE conditional skipping vs VERIFY/SEC/REL mandatory gates
assurance_matrix.evidence: Conditional sub-agents (DEV-CMS, DEV-UI, DEV-CODE) can be SKIPPED_NOT_APPLICABLE only with non-empty skip_reason. Mandatory gates (DEV-VERIFY, DEV-SEC, DEV-REL) cannot be excluded on release-producing workflows.

assurance_matrix.scope: Malformed dependencies, cyclic graphs, duplicate step IDs
assurance_matrix.evidence: Policy validation rejects cyclic dependencies, forward references, duplicate step IDs, empty steps, and missing skip reasons with PolicyViolationError.

assurance_matrix.scope: Source code and manifest prompt-injection override attempts
assurance_matrix.evidence: Injected instructions in comments or dependency metadata cannot downgrade risk_class, skip mandatory verification/security gates, or alter sandbox capabilities.

assurance_matrix.scope: SHA-256 over canonical JSON byte representation
assurance_matrix.evidence: Plan hash computation is deterministic and changes upon mutation of any field (objective, risk_class, acceptance_criteria, dependencies).

assurance_matrix.dimension: Provenance Recording & W3C PROV Ledger Binding
assurance_matrix.scope: Integration with ProvenanceRecorder and tenant chain
assurance_matrix.evidence: DevelopmentAgent records immutable W3C PROV event with agent=DEV-PLAN, plan_hash, and attempt_id tied to the tenant ledger.

assurance_matrix.dimension: HITL State Machine Transition & Ed25519 Token Integrity
assurance_matrix.evidence: State machine enforces candidate_hash match on RESULT_SEALED, and verifies Ed25519 approval token signature and expiry on transition to APPROVED.

assurance_matrix.scope: HITL rejection and revision attempt generation
assurance_matrix.evidence: Rejection transitions to CORRECTION_REQUIRED -> RETRY_PREPARED -> PLANNING; generates Attempt 2 plan (version 2, new hash, feedback in assumptions/unresolved items) while leaving Attempt 1 immutable.

assurance_matrix.dimension: Downstream Sub-Agent Handoff & Plan Authority Enforcement
assurance_matrix.scope: Downstream execution of DEV-CMS, DEV-UI, DEV-CODE against approved plan
assurance_matrix.evidence: Downstream agents validate plan authority fail-closed when a step is skipped; authorized steps consume exact predecessor plan hash.

defect_remediations.defect: Operation dispatch for inspect_dependencies, introspect_schema, and parse_manifest evaluated raw operation parameter instead of effective_operation, causing dispatch to miss when operation was provided in payload dict.
defect_remediations.resolution: Updated conditional checks to evaluate effective_operation consistently across all planning operations.

defect_remediations.defect: Direct invocation of DevelopmentPlanningAgent.generate_plan lacked grant expiration, tenant scope, and sandbox capability validation, relying solely on caller-level checks.
defect_remediations.resolution: Added direct fail-closed checks for grant expiration (is_expired/expires_at), non-empty tenant scope, and S_CODE capability restriction.
